title: OL-20261122-2: Re-grade Unlearn entries when new reviews pile up
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** GET https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/api/review-queue.json returns a non-empty queue
**Done check:** grep:instances/unlearn/worker/lab.js::export function regrade
**Status:** closed

The evidence loop flags entries with 3 or more unreviewed new reviews at /api/review-queue.json; re-grading an entry (reading the new reviews into its grade and marking leads reviewed) is now automated.

**Disposition:** fixed (2026-11-22, UNLEARN-LAB-1)

**Evidence:** instances/unlearn/worker/lab.js triage labels each new review with a quote that must be in its abstract, and regrade() marks entries reinforced (strength one step up) or challenged (shown on the page and kept on /api/review-queue.json); tests instances/unlearn/worker/lab.test.mjs.
